column1: # The settings files that can change what an agent asks before a tool call.
# "kit session start" records each file that exists in the conditions of the
# session (RUN/sessions/NAME/conditions), so that a result names the
# settings that were in effect. Read by session.sh and session.ps1.
# Each line that does not start with "#" has 4 fields, separated by tabs.
#   agent  claude, codex, agy, cursor-agent or opencode.
#   scope  home     a path below the home of the session.
#          project  a path below the work folder or a folder above it. The
#                   kit looks in each folder from the work folder up to the
#          machine  an absolute path. A machine file applies to each
#                   account and each home, also to a throwaway home.
#   path   The path. "/" separates folders on each OS.
# A kit-made home (throwaway or fixture) holds no private data: the
# conditions show the content of each home file. A real home and a machine
# file can hold private data: the conditions show only the SHA-256, the
# size, and the top-level keys of a JSON file. A project file shows the
# number of folders above the work folder, not the path.
# The paths come from the documentation of each agent and from the strings
# in the binary of agy 1.5.1. A path that an agent does not read does no
# harm. A missing path is a gap: the conditions do not show that file.
